body: Spec reread sharpens my pending disposition request: findings 1, 2, and 4 are already mandated by accepted story-output-bundle-spec §§5, 7.5, 11.1 (joined text identities and receipts; strict decode byte-position+charset receipt; retained opaque or manifest-bound payload closure). Only SemanticOutcome.NotRequested is additional vocabulary under §7.3's 'at least'. I posted corrected public disposition post-01M1D4R04BFCNDDFD1ZFZB2SEM and superseded my weaker prior post. f28 is therefore withdrawn on three current-spec defects. Honest correction likely requires public/wire design, so I remain paused for your exact scope.
